- badge: "Find your forever friend. Open your heart to puppy love."
- paragraph: "Find your perfect match. Open your heart to unconditional love and start your happy puppy journey today. Your new best friend is waiting."
- date and place: "Find your forever best friend. Adopt a puppy today."
- button: "Adopt a Puppy"
- price: "Adoption Fees Start At $499"
- 6 featureItems in a grid, each: price, sentence or two:
  1. "$250" — "Meet a playful golden retriever ready for adventure and endless cuddles. Perfect for active families."
  2. "$350" — "Sweet beagle mix seeking a home with lots of attention and playtime. A loyal companion awaits you."
  3. "$400" — "Energetic husky puppy ready to explore the great outdoors. Ideal for couples looking for an exciting bond."
  4. "$200" — "Calm labrador puppy, perfect for families and quiet evenings. A gentle soul ready to spread joy."
  5. "$300" — "Adorable french bulldog, known for its charming personality and playful spirit. Great for apartment living."
  6. "$225" — "Spotted terrier mix, full of boundless energy and love. Ready to become your best friend."

Section "feature cards" (light band). Top to bottom:
- paragraph: "Meet your perfect match! Discover curated puppy profiles, interactive adoption guides, and heartwarming stories to find your best new friend."
- small print: "Adoption requires commitment and responsible ownership."
- button: "View Profiles & Apply"
- button: "Browse adoption profiles"

Section "gallery" (light band). Top to bottom:
- date and place: "Cozy afternoons and playful adventures in your forever home."

Section "how it works" (light band). Top to bottom:
- badge: "Swipe through profiles. Match with your perfect match instantly. Find your best friend now."
- date and place: "Find your perfect furry friend. Browse adorable puppies and start your adoption journey today."
- who said it: a name and a role: "Ava, Lead Adopter Coach"
- a photo (animal-dog.webp)

Section "call to action" (light band). Top to bottom:
- who said it: a name and a role: "Sarah, Adoption Coordinator"
- quote: "My new best friend is the perfect addition to our home! Puppy Love found my soulmate."
- price: "Adopt a Friend Today"
- small print: "Apply now and start your loving journey!"
- sub-line: "Find your perfect furry match today and start your happy journey with a loving companion."
- 6 testimonialCards in a single column, each: photo, title:
  1. "Meet Our Wonderful Puppies"
  2. "View All Adoption Profiles"
  3. "Start Your Adoption Journey"
  4. "Learn About Our Process"
  5. "Read Success Stories"
  6. "Apply to Adopt Today"

Section "testimonials" (light band). Top to bottom:
- small print: "Adoption requires commitment. Read all profiles carefully."
- sub-line: "These amazing pups make every day brighter and fill your heart with unconditional joy."

Section "sign-up or contact form" (light band). Top to bottom:
- quote: "My new best friend arrived! Puppy Love found the perfect companion for our family."
- who said it: a name and a role: "Sarah, Adoption Coordinator"
- headline: "Ready for unconditional love? Join our puppy family now!"
